thread:
Maya: quick sync — sprint sherpa update for hotpath perf. two things: (1) throughput regression on v2-kernel after last PR, (2) KV eviction flapping in canary. cc @Ravi @Zoe :wave
Ravi: saw the regression in the perf dashboard this morning, digging. suspecting a change in microbatch glue. PR #7123 touched batcher/slot allocator. I can take ownership of the immediate rollback if we want.
Zoe: thanks. I ran a local repro with a synthetic workload: 512 tokens, batch size ~8. latency tail jumps when `slot_wait` > 30ms. stack traces point to `alloc_slots()` in kernel_scheduler.
Luca: I can look at the KV side — the canary shows repeated evict/load cycles every ~45s. current threshold is 0.65 usage. lowering to 0.5 temporarily helped but that's risky for throughput.
Hannah: posting quick telemetry: `curl http://metrics/api?query=hotpath_latency_tail` shows 99p spiking from 120ms -> 350ms at 09:12 UTC. linking grafana: https://grafana/reports/abc123 :frowning:
Maya: plan proposal: rollback PR #7123 to restore baseline, then patch microbatch allocator in a follow-up. for KV: set eviction threshold to 0.55 on the canary pool and monitor 10m, if stable promote rollout. sound ok?
Ravi: +1 for rollback. I'll cut a revert and ping infra for a fast canary. will post PR link in thread.
ops-bot: deploy started for canary:cluster-hotpath with image redwood/runtime:v2026-09-12-revert. id=deploy-8842 ETA ~4m.
Luca: changing eviction threshold now: `kubectl -n runtime set env ds/hotpath KVS_EVICT_THRESHOLD=0.55` — done. watching logs.
Zoe: I pushed a tiny instrumentation PR that logs `slot_wait` and `alloc_latency_ms` for slow requests — PR #7139. if revert lands, we should still keep that to get more signal.
Maya: good. @Hannah can you keep an eye on the 99p and any error budget alerts? set a deck on the incident board if it regresses.
Hannah: on it. I've added a card and hooked pager rule to the hotpath alert. will update every 15m.
Ravi: revert PR: https://git/repo/pulls/7140 — rolled back, canary deploy completed. early look: 99p down to ~140ms, still a bit above baseline but improving.
deploy-bot: canary promotion check: success=ok, errors=0, throughput delta=-1.8% (within tolerance).
Luca: KV eviction stabilized in the canary after threshold change, evict cycles dropped from 3/min -> 0-1/min.
Zoe: with revert + extra logs we can run a short perf test and collect traces. I'll schedule a 30m soak with the synthetic load and post results.
Maya: awesome. next steps (async): Ravi to root cause #7123 and open a targeted fix, Zoe to run soak + traces, Luca to draft plan for adaptive eviction thresholding, Hannah to monitor and keep ops board updated. ping here when tasks are done. :thumbsup:
Ravi: assigning self to RCA, will aim for PR today.
Zoe: soak scheduled at 10:30 UTC, I'll post trace links.
Luca: drafting adaptive eviction RFC, will share a short proposal by EOD.
Hannah: will keep updating. no pages so far.
Maya: thanks team. if anything unexpected pops up, call out in #eng-oncall and tag me. closing the loop here. :lock:
